items.prompt: 你的英国笔友 Tom 想了解中国中学生的一天。请以 "My School Day" 为题写一篇短文，介绍你从早到晚的主要安排，并说明你最喜欢哪一段时间以及原因。
suggestedStructure: 开头一句点明主题：介绍自己就读的年级与学校类型
按时间顺序描述上午的安排（起床、早读、上午的课）
描述中午与下午的安排（午餐、社团、体育活动）
说明晚上如何复习与休息
结尾说明你最喜欢的时段并给出一条理由

advancedPatterns.name: 时间状语前置
advancedPatterns.template: At + 时间, 主语 + 谓语.
advancedPatterns.sample: At seven in the morning, I read English aloud with my classmates.

advancedPatterns.name: not only ... but also ...
advancedPatterns.template: not only + A + but also + B
advancedPatterns.sample: We not only study hard but also play basketball together.

advancedPatterns.name: 原因状语从句
advancedPatterns.sample: I like the afternoon best because we have art class then.

paragraphs.en: My name is Li Hua and I am a Grade Eight student in a middle school in Nanjing. My school day is busy but happy.
paragraphs.cn: 我叫李华，是南京一所中学八年级的学生。我的校园生活忙碌而快乐。
paragraphs.note: 开头交代身份与总体感受，为下文定基调。

paragraphs.en: First, I get up at six thirty and arrive at school before seven twenty. Then we have morning reading, and after that four classes begin.
paragraphs.cn: 首先，我六点半起床，七点二十前到校。接着是早读，之后开始上四节课。
paragraphs.note: 用 First / Then / After that 串起上午时间线。

paragraphs.en: At noon I have lunch with my friends in the dining hall. In the afternoon we not only study science but also join club activities such as football and painting.
paragraphs.cn: 中午我和朋友在食堂吃饭。下午我们不仅学习科学，还参加足球、绘画等社团活动。
paragraphs.note: 使用 not only ... but also ... 提升句式分。

paragraphs.en: Finally, I review my lessons for an hour in the evening. I like the afternoon best because I can do sports with my classmates then.
paragraphs.cn: 最后，晚上我复习一小时功课。我最喜欢下午，因为那时可以和同学一起运动。
paragraphs.note: 结尾用 Finally 收束并给出理由。

items.prompt: 学校英语角正在征集主题为 "A Person I Admire" 的短文。请介绍一位你敬佩的人（可以是家人、老师或身边的普通人），写出他/她做过的一件具体的事，以及这件事对你的影响。
suggestedStructure: 开门见山点出这个人是谁以及你们的关系
用两三句描述他/她的外貌或性格特点
完整叙述一件具体的事（时间、地点、发生了什么）
说明这件事让你学到了什么
结尾表达你希望成为怎样的人

advancedPatterns.name: who 引导的定语从句
advancedPatterns.sample: My grandmother is a person who never gives up.

advancedPatterns.name: so ... that ...
advancedPatterns.template: so + 形容词 + that + 主谓
advancedPatterns.sample: She was so patient that I finally learned to ride a bike.

items.prompt: 你所在的城市正在推广垃圾分类。请写一封给校长的英文建议信，提出两条在校园内推广垃圾分类的具体做法，并说明这样做的好处。
suggestedStructure: 写明写信目的：为校园垃圾分类提出建议
提出第一条建议并说明如何执行
提出第二条建议并说明如何执行
概括这两条建议能带来的好处
礼貌收尾，表达希望被采纳的意愿

advancedPatterns.name: 虚拟建议句
advancedPatterns.template: I suggest that + 主语 + (should) + 动词原形
advancedPatterns.sample: I suggest that every classroom should have four coloured bins.

advancedPatterns.name: It is + 形容词 + to do
advancedPatterns.template: It is + adj. + to + 动词原形
advancedPatterns.sample: It is important to teach students how to sort rubbish correctly.

advancedPatterns.name: 被动语态
advancedPatterns.sample: Waste paper can be collected once a week by the class monitor.
